publisher: Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry, Construction Codes and Licensing Division
ownership: Publisher-offered construction credential exports; DLI's notice describes its information and documents as public domain.
allowed_use: bounded anonymous HTTPS notice and schema checks
conditional internal acquisition of the two fixed exports after fresh unchanged article evidence and enrolled app-operation prerequisites
streaming business-credential selection with unselected and rejected personal values excluded before durable staging
immutable internal selected evidence and local-review normalized records; local replay without another acquisition
prohibited_use: accepting agreements, creating accounts or bypassing provider restrictions
treating personal qualification records as businesses, registrations as licenses, or Issued status as verified business operations
publishing source documents, raw CSV, contacts, rejected personal values, logos or implied DLI endorsement
inferring physical sites, geocodes, ZIP assignments, closure, parent company, ownership, NAICS or unique business identity without evidence
treating a prior source-use binding as permission for a new acquisition after its freshness window
attribution: Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry, Construction Codes and Licensing Division
retention: Keep immutable selected evidence and normalized bundles for reuse; no automatic deletion. Do not retain full CSV or rejected personal values.
redistribution: Record-level and document redistribution is not authorized by this profile. Preserve direct publisher links, attribution and non-endorsement boundaries.
personal_data_handling: Business/DBA names may identify sole proprietors and reported addresses may be residences. Keep record-level evidence internal/local-review-only and do not claim a verified operating location.
notice_scope: Complete single article HTML, including article navigation and links, with CRLF normalized to LF. External linked pages and page content outside the article are not included in these fingerprints; this is not a comprehensive legal determination.
